expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, time, and delivery fee, which looks like duplicated or placeholder content.
The category chip row and restaurant carousels are clipped at the right edge ('Healthy' and the burger card are partially cut off), which can look broken even if horizontal scrolling is intended.
The lower 'Popular right now' card is cut off at the bottom of the visible area above the tab bar, making the page feel abruptly cropped.
The search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' appears light gray on a light background and may have weak contrast for some users.
